blockingIssues.description: `assemblePreparedAgentLoop` still contains three targeted object-literal methods without explicit return annotations (`switchActiveModel`, `persistRecoveredModelSelection`, and `captureErrorClassificationContext`). The feature description and expected behavior required the agent-loop/service functions in this scope to receive explicit return types.

The streaming callback passed to `streamText` (`onChunk`) still has no explicit return type in this feature commit, leaving another targeted agent-loop helper unannotated despite the explicit-return-type sweep requirement.
`emitHistoryPrepared` remains without an explicit `: void` return type in this commit even though `prepare.ts` is part of the targeted agent-loop scope described for the feature.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update refactor-worker guidance to explicitly allow and document scoped validation fallbacks (especially diff-scoped repo-standards checks) when known unrelated repo-wide repo-standards failures exist, and clarify how verification-only or async-regression coverage sessions should record such deviations.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Every reviewed type-safety feature reported some refactor-worker guidance gap around global repo-standards assumptions, scoped validation fallbacks, or verification/test-harness edge cases.

rejectedObservations.observation: The `refactor-worker` skill requires full-repo `npm run lint` and `npm run check:repo-standards`, but this mission has unrelated pre-existing failures in those commands. The successful worker had to fall back to targeted Biome checks on touched files and record the deviation manually. The skill should document that fallback path for debt-heavy repos.
